name: Mentors
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of mentors as counselors who provide wisdom and guidance rooted in godly understanding. Psalms 119:24 refers to testimonies as counselors, emphasizing the value of divine instruction, while Proverbs 15:22 and 20:5 reveal that wise counsel is essential for establishing plans and drawing out deep understanding. Additionally, Proverbs 22:6 stresses the importance of early mentorship in training a child in the right path, ensuring lasting faithfulness.
